target: templates/observability/dashboards/*.json — the checked-in output stays valid v8 dashboard JSON with the full 14-panel set (gates drift between dashboards.md and the shipped files, without needing python3 in the eval sandbox)
cmd: cd "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; jq -s '{boards: length, total_panels: (map(.tabs[0].panels | length) | add), titles: map(.title) | sort}' templates/observability/dashboards/*.dashboard.json

checks.expr: .titles | any(. | test("Tonight")) and any(. | test("Factory")) and any(. | test("Spec Economics"))
